business_summary.text: Sumitomo Chemical India is an agrochemicals company making technical grade actives and formulations (insecticides, herbicides, fungicides, PGRs, metal phosphides, animal nutrition and public health) across five plants, selling domestically through 15,000+ distributors and exporting to ~50 countries.

call_points.text: No revenue or margin guidance given; the filing says the business is best monitored annually given seasonality.
Q1 domestic demand was hit by a delayed monsoon, 40% rainfall deficit and ~20% lower early kharif sowing.
Exports grew 26% YoY to 16% of revenue, led by South America, Asia ex-India and Africa; Japan and North America declined.
Overall optimal capacity utilisation is ~80% to 90% for technical grade actives (TGAI).
Topgrain and Helibax (Pyridalyl + Emamectin) remain on track for launch during Q2FY27.
Board reconstitution effective 1 September 2026: Dr. Suresh Ramachandran becomes Managing Director; Chetan Shah moves to Non-Executive Chairman.
The company plans to invest ~15% of consolidated EBITDA every year in manufacturing upgradation and capacity expansion.
Management remains cautiously optimistic for FY27, monitoring monsoon forecasts and geopolitical headwinds while maintaining pricing flexibility.

operating_notes.text: India elevated to same tier as Japan and Brazil for early-stage testing and introduction of new molecules from SCC's global pipeline.
Overall optimal capacity utilisation is ~80% to 90% for technical grade actives (TGAI).
Exports were 16% of Q1FY27 revenue, up from 13% a year ago, with growth of 26% YoY.
Top 10 products contribute less than 45% of total annual revenue and no single molecule more than ~17%.

timeline.summary: Tomohito Fujiwara, General Manager, declared no encumbrance on 37,435,930 shares of Sumitomo Chemical India Limited as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
CRISIL reaffirmed CRISIL AA/Stable rating on Sumitomo Chemical India's ₹200 Cr bank facilities.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹683.74 Cr (+0.6% YoY), net profit ₹111.32 Cr (+11.6% YoY).
Sumitomo Chemical India Ltd’s Board, led by Deepika Trivedi, recommended ₹1.30 final dividend per share (₹64.89M total) on 26 May 2026, payable post-AGM by 3 Aug 2026.
Sumitomo Chemical India Limited’s **Deepika Trivedi** scheduled an earnings call for 28 May 2026 at 2:00 PM IST to discuss Q4FY26 and FY26 financials.
Sumitomo Chemical India held its Q4 and FY26 earnings call on 28 May 2026, reporting record profitability and announcing upcoming leadership transitions.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹907.31 Cr (-2.4% YoY), net profit ₹157.4 Cr (-11.5% YoY).
Audio recording of earnings call held on 27th October 2026 uploaded.
